summary: Lion Group Holding Ltd, a Singapore-based, Cayman-incorporated broker-dealer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing the September 28, 2026 closing of a Subsequent Offering of a $3,000,000 senior secured convertible debenture due September 28, 2029, sold to an existing institutional buyer under the June 17, 2025 Securities Purchase Agreement, as amended December 5, 2025. Proceeds fund general working capital and the Skyfame Realty (Holdings) Limited liquidation restructuring (HK:00059), the Hong Kong equivalent of a Chapter 11 reorganization; none will collateralize or purchase tokens. Watch for additional financing needs and potential dilution from conversion.
